user.title: Step 1 of 5 – Installation
user.description: Choose how your heat pump is controlled and which kind of pump you have. The next steps link the sensors; you can change everything here later via 'Reconfigure'.

data.pump_source_filter: Only show that integration's entities for the pump fields

data_description.control_mode: Which water temperature your heat pump's target refers to.
data_description.setpoint_step: Resolution of the heat pump (many Tuya pumps: 1 °C). The control averages over time automatically.
data_description.pump_profile: Alsavo/Tuya uses tried and tested starting values; 'General' starts more cautiously and then learns by itself.
data_description.pump_source: For example localtuya. Used to suggest the right pump sensors and to shorten the lists.
data_description.pump_source_filter: Off = you see all entities (handy when sensors come from several integrations).

basis.title: Step 2 of 5 – Room and outdoors
basis.description: Room and outdoor temperature are required. Fields are pre-filled when a good candidate was found; please check them.

data_description.room_temp_sensor: Most representative indoor temperature, for example in the living room.
data_description.extra_room_sensors: All rooms share one water circuit, so heating per room is not possible. Extra rooms can be guarded though (for example a bedroom must not get colder than a minimum).
data_description.room_mode: Main room = steers, extra rooms only guard a minimum. Average = mean of all rooms. Coldest = the coldest room steers.
data_description.outside_temp_sensor: Preferably a sensor that is not in direct sun.
data_description.flow_temp_sensor: Needed to learn how the floor heats up.
data_description.return_temp_sensor: Needed to learn the floor model (or use a floor sensor).
data_description.floor_temp_sensor: Optional, makes the model more accurate. Without it the return temperature is used.

pomp.title: Step 3 of 5 – Heat pump
pomp.description: The more of this data, the smarter the control (frequency table, COP, defrost detection). Everything is optional.

data_description.compressor_freq_sensor: Tells the control when the pump is really heating.
data_description.voltage_sensor: Only if there is no power sensor.
data_description.current_sensor: Only if there is no power sensor.
data_description.flow_rate_sensors: For calculating thermal power and COP. Several sensors (parallel circuits) are added up.
data_description.coil_sensor: Optional. Allows faster defrost detection and measures whether a defrost really melts the ice (coil must reach 25-45 °C).
data_description.unit_outside_sensor: Optional. NOT used for control (it can freeze up), only to learn defrosting and to report sensor deviations.

aansturing.title: Step 4 of 5 – Control
aansturing.description: Leave both empty to only measure and learn first (shadow mode); nothing is controlled then.

data_description.target_setpoint_entity: The entity that sets the heat pump's desired water temperature (for example Tuya Local).
data_description.heatpump_switch: Optional. Only used in summer or in case of serious overheating.

extras.title: Step 5 of 5 – Extras
extras.description: Tick what you want to connect; each choice adds a short screen. Ticking nothing is fine too.

data_description.extra_weer_prijs: Forecast of outdoor temperature/sun and cheap hours.
data_description.extra_zon_net: Free heat when there is a solar surplus and peak protection.
data_description.extra_ramen: Heating pauses when something stays open too long.
data_description.extra_aanwezigheid: Lower setpoint when nobody is home, pre-heat before returning.
data_description.extra_tapwater: Only if the pump also makes hot water.
data_description.extra_meldingen: Frost, ice, a room that is too cold, sensor problems and the weekly report.

data_description.weather_entity: For forecasting outdoor temperature and sun.
data_description.electricity_price_sensor: A forecast in the attributes (Nordpool, EPEX, Frank Energie, ENTSO-E) is recognised automatically.

data_description.pv_power_sensor: With a surplus, cheaper/free heat is stored in the floor.
data_description.grid_power_sensor: Power drawn from the grid (positive = import). If the limit is exceeded for long, heating pauses briefly.

ramen.title: Windows and doors
ramen.description: Pick as many sensors as you have.

data_description.open_sensors: If something stays open longer than the set time, heating pauses (with frost protection) and nothing is learned.

data_description.presence_entities: If nobody is home, the temperature drops to the away setpoint.
data_description.holiday_entity: When on, the away setpoint always applies.
data_description.return_time_entity: For example an input_datetime. Underfloor heating is slow: with a return time it pre-heats in time.

data_description.dhw_temp_sensor: Only fill in if the heat pump also makes hot water.
data_description.dhw_switch: Switch that starts/stops a hot water cycle.
data_description.dhw_setpoint_entity: Optional: set to the wanted temperature during a cycle.

meldingen.title: Notifications
meldingen.description: Choose which devices receive notifications (for example the Home Assistant app on your phone).

data_description.notify_services: Important messages only; you can switch each kind off or adjust the thresholds in the settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Smart Heat Pump can be set up.

options.hoofd: Main room steers, extra rooms guard

reset_model.name: Reset learned model
reset_model.description: Clear the learned house and floor model and the evening correction.

exporteer.name: Export settings and learned data
exporteer.description: Writes all settings, switches and (optionally) the learned model to slimme_warmtepomp_export.json in your config folder and also returns them as the response.

leerstatus.name: Include learned model
leerstatus.description: Include the learned house and floor model, the frequency table and the heating curve.

importeer.name: Import settings and learned data
importeer.description: Reads slimme_warmtepomp_export.json from your config folder (or the data you pass) and applies it. Values are kept within the allowed limits.

leerstatus.name: Include learned model
leerstatus.description: Also restore the learned model. Off = settings and switches only.

data.name: Data
data.description: Optional. The contents of an export; without it the file is used.

unavailable.title: Sensor without a value
unavailable.description: {entity} ({role}) has not given a value for some time. The control uses a fallback until the sensor is back. Check the battery, range or integration.

stale.title: Sensor is not updating
stale.description: {entity} ({role}) has not been updated for {hours} hours. The sensor or its connection has probably stalled.

implausible.title: Implausible sensor value
implausible.description: {entity} ({role}) reports {value}, which cannot be right. Check the unit and the sensor.

outside.title: Outdoor temperature deviates
outside.description: The control's outdoor temperature ({a} °C) differs {diff} °C from the pump's own outdoor sensor ({b} °C). One of the sensors probably gives a wrong value (sun on the sensor?).
